resources.string: Zeta Home button

On a TV it does three things: it sees the remote\'s Home button pressed and opens Zeta instead of the TV\'s own home screen; from the \"shutdown\" panel, when you choose it, it opens the TV\'s power menu or puts it to sleep; and it shows the call and message notices from a phone you paired over other apps. It touches no other key, reads nothing on the screen, records nothing and sends nothing anywhere.
